Adrien Rabiot.note: Watch Rabiot for creating a better angle for the next pass. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Adrien Rabiot.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Aurelien Tchouameni.note: Tchouaméni's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Aurelien Tchouameni.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Bradley Barcola.note: Barcola stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Bradley Barcola.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Brice Samba.note: Samba is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements.
Brice Samba.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。

Dayot Upamecano.note: Watch Upamecano for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Dayot Upamecano.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。留意他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Desire Doue.note: Watch Doué for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Desire Doue.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Ibrahima Konate.note: Konaté stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Ibrahima Konate.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Jean-Philippe Mateta.note: Watch Mateta for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Jean-Philippe Mateta.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Jules Kounde.note: Watch Koundé for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Jules Kounde.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。留意他如何先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Kylian Mbappe.note: Mbappé's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. Near goal, he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. When defenders crowd him, he looks for the next pass instead of forcing a shot.
Kylian Mbappe.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在看到空当后的爆发速度上。接近球门时，他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。面对多人包夹时，他会寻找下一脚传球，而不是勉强射门。

Lucas Digne.note: Digne is defined by delivering the ball without needing much space. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Lucas Digne.noteZh: 他靠在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力与同位置球员拉开差异。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Lucas Hernandez.note: Hernández's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Lucas Hernandez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Maghnes Akliouche.note: Akliouche stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Maghnes Akliouche.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Malo Gusto.note: Gusto stands out for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Malo Gusto.noteZh: 他的突出特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Manu Kone.note: Koné stands out for using strength without slowing the next action. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Manu Kone.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Marcus Thuram.note: Thuram is defined by starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Marcus Thuram.noteZh: 他靠在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动与同位置球员拉开差异。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Maxence Lacroix.note: Lacroix stands out for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Maxence Lacroix.noteZh: 他的突出特点是防线暴露后的回追速度。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Michael Olise.note: Olise's edge is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Michael Olise.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Mike Maignan.note: Maignan is defined by staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He leaves his line early when a through ball escapes the back line. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Mike Maignan.noteZh: 他靠在射门方向明确前保持身体平衡与同位置球员拉开差异。他会直塞球越过后防时及时出击。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Ngolo Kante.note: Kanté stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Ngolo Kante.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ousmane Dembele.note: Dembélé is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Ousmane Dembele.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Rayan Cherki.note: Watch Cherki for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Rayan Cherki.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Robin Risser.note: Risser is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements.
Robin Risser.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。

Theo Hernandez.note: Watch Hernandez for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Theo Hernandez.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。留意他如何承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Warren Zaire-Emery.note: Zaïre-Emery stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Warren Zaire-Emery.noteZh: 他的突出特点是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

William Saliba.note: Saliba's edge is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
William Saliba.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。
